author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Anniversary Season Trailer for The Division 2, the hit third-person action co-op shooter developed by Massive Entertainment. Players can now access an all-new season celebrating 10 years of The Division. Experience new activities and rewards rolling out each week of the four-week season with two brand-new Global Events inspired by the original game. A new limited-time Realism Mode is also available that brings a more tense gameplay experience. The Anniversary Season for The Division 2 is available now.
title: The Division 2 - Official Anniversary Season Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the New DLC Teaser Trailer for The Division 2, the hit third-person action co-op shooter developed by Massive Entertainment. Players will dive straight into Central Park as a new threat emerges for The Division to take on. Explore the new DLC coming soon to The Division 2 later in 2026.
title: The Division 2 - Official New DLC Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer for Tales of the Shire, a Lord of The Rings life simulation game developed by Weta Workshop. Players will live out the Hobbit life to carve out a simple life in Middle-Earth. Meet characters from the wonderful world of Lord of The Rings in Tales of the Shire, launching on March 25 for Nintendo Switch 2, with the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Pre-Order Trailer for Tides of Tomorrow, an upcoming first-person narrative-driven multiplayer game developed by Digixart. Players will explore a world submerged in a flood as the population struggles to survive on the post-apocalyptic ocean planet. Make key decisions, engage in dialogue with a variety of characters, and steer the events as you see fit in Tides of Tomorrow, launching on April 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
title: Tides of Tomorrow - Official Pre-Order Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Becoming Pablo announcement trailer for this upcoming cartel strategy simulator game. Becoming Pablo will be available on PC via Steam.

Becoming Pablo is set in the gritty underworld of the 1970s–90s Colombian drug trade, where power is earned through strategy, cunning decisions, and perseverance. Players will lead their cartels by conquering territories, managing sprawling operations across regions like Nigeria and Korea, and outmaneuvering rival factions, and establish themselves as the true kings of the brutal drug trade. Whether it be through expanding their domains, defending hometurf, or navigating cartel politics, every choice made will determine the empire’s rise or contribute to its downfall.
title: Becoming Pablo - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths in this trailer for the simulation game. Perform complex repairs and maintenance to become the ultimate truck mechanic. Get behind the wheel of your truck, throw your trusty tools in the back, and set out on an extreme adventure across the South American wilderness! Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Path will be available on PC.
title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Official Trailer

T

author: GameTrailers
description:
Rotwood leaves early access and is available now on Steam and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the Rotwood launch trailer for this side-scrolling brawler roguelite game. The Rotwood launch update features a narrative conclusion and cinematics, final boss including a new unique location, three new superfrenzy runs + Bosses (Frenzy Rook, Shelldrake, and Grimhollow), weapon and equipment tuning adjustments, and much more.

The world has fallen into chaos, and it’s up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts that threaten your home. Choose your weapon, upgrade your gear, sharpen your skills, and get ready to take on the frenzied foes of Rotwood! In Rotwood, play solo or co-op with up to three friends, fighting increasingly challenging encounters as you battle your way through 8 unique locations.

#Rotwood #BrawlerGame
title: Rotwood - Official Launch Trailer | Nintendo Indie World 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered, a remastered version of the classic action-adventure game developed by PlayEveryWare and Crystal Dynamics. Players will assume the role of Kain, a vampire, alongside his lieutenant Raziel, as they fight through the treacherous world of Nosgoth. 

Experience enhanced features for the modern-era such as enhanced visuals, modernized camera options, atmospheric improvements, and more. Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store), with a release on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date.

#LegacyOfKain #DefianceRemastered
title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
To fight the Bug, we must understand the Bug - We can ill afford another Klendathu! Check out the latest Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! trailer for the upcoming FPS game to see what to expect with the Bug Mode. The Bug Mode allows Troopers to experience the battle from the Arachnid side, where you can play as the Assassin Bug. The Assassin Bug can change between three different attack forms: Warrior, Hopper, and Tanker variants. In the Bug Mode, you can explore each of the four training areas. Troopers will need to decimate each Terror Zone in the area to progress - confronting the firepower of the mighty Mobile Infantry. Lead the Arachnid strategy as The Assassin Bug: The Assassin Bug uses pheromone spray to direct nearby allied Bugs, as well as recruiting new Bugs for the fight at Bug Nests.

Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, and GOG on March 16, 2026.

#StarshipTroopersUltimateBugWar #ActionShooter
title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! - Official Bug Mode Trailer

description:
Don't miss the Midnight Launch Trailer for World of Warcraft, the legendary MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players can now experience the latest Midnight Expansion that sees Xal’atath’s forces bringing the Voidstorm to Azeroth and darkness alongside it. The Alliance and the Horde join forces to embark on new Delves, dungeons, and raids to defend their home at all costs. The Midnight Expansion for World of Warcraft is available now for PC.

#WorldOfWarcraft #MMORPG
title: World of Warcraft - Official Midnight Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian in this latest trailer for the upcoming narrative role-playing game telling the story of a crown prince of the Blessed Arknian Empire. You possess great power, but are also burdened by duty. Can you change the world and stay true to yourself? Every decision comes with a cost. The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian will be available on PC, and a playtest is now available.
title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian - Official Playtest Trailer

description: Take a look at the Console Release Date Trailer for Cryptical Path, an action hack-and-slash roguelite developed by Old Skull Games. Players will embody the Architect to assemble rooms, engage difficult enemies, and attain upgrades and perks from room to room. Come to terms with the mysteries of the Architect in Cryptical Path, launching on March 4 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch, with the game being available now on PC (Steam).
title: Cryptical Path - Official Console Release Date Trailer

description:
Watch the Apex Legends x Gundam event trailer for the upcoming collaboration between the battle royale game and the legendary Gundam series. The Gundam event brings iconic weapons, Gundam-inspired cosmetics, and a reborn Broken Moon. Step into the endless waltz and fight with the power of a Gundam!
